messages:
sophia: Quick Q — planning to add a GH Actions workflow that runs terraform apply on merge to `main` for infra repo. How do we stop ArgoCD from reconciling service apps (they'll try to sync before the LB/secret is created) so we don't get 502 flaps? Anyone tried a configmap lock pattern?

matt: We ran into this in prod. We ended up using a central 'deploy-lock' ConfigMap in the infra-cluster. GH Actions flips it to `ready: true` after apply, ArgoCD app has a pre-sync hook that waits for it. Works okay.

liam: +1 for configmap. Example pre-sync k8s Job in app's manifests:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: wait-for-infra
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: wait
        image: bitnami/kubectl
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","until kubectl get cm deploy-lock -o jsonpath='{.data.ready}' | grep true; do sleep 5; done"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

olivia: If we use jobs as pre-sync hooks, remember ArgoCD will mark the app as 'synchronizing' while the job runs. That hides health until it finishes. Also add TTL to avoid stuck syncs if something goes wrong.

sophia: Nice. What about cross-repo perms? The infra GH Action runs in infra repo and needs kubeconfig to flip the CM — how are we managing creds? don't want to give every repo cluster-admin.

matt: We created a short-lived KubeConfig secret via OIDC token exchange in GH Actions, scoped to a service account with just patch/get on the `deploy-lock` cm and patch on namespace. Here's a minimal GH Actions step:
```yaml
- name: Set deploy-lock
  uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v2
  with:
    kubeconfig: ${{ secrets.INFRA_DEPLOY_KUBECONFIG }}
- run: |
    kubectl patch cm deploy-lock -p '{"data":{"ready":"true"}}' -n infra-system
```

liam: Alternatively, we can push a "infra-ready" label to the ArgoCD repo as a file (e.g., /infra-status/ready.txt) and ArgoCD's repo-server can read files? That's messier.

olivia: FYI we have an internal infra-bot (infra-bot) that can post a repo-dispatch to ArgoCD to trigger a sync when deploy-lock flips. Might be cleaner than constant polling.

infra-bot: (bot) posted check: deploy-lock flipped -> triggered argo sync for apps: svc-frontend, svc-auth

sophia: OK sounds like plan. Action items:
- matt: add GH Action step to patch `deploy-lock` after terraform apply
- olivia: add pre-sync Job hook to apps that need infra dependency (we'll add TTL and timeout)
- liam: write runbook for failure modes

matt: I'll open PR today. tagging @olivia @liam :thumbsup:

sophia: Thanks all. moving forward with the ConfigMap lock approach. I'll update infra runbook when PR is merged. :rocket:
